data_output.description: The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must be int64 values arange(len(valid_rows)) in canonical validation-row order, and scores must be a finite one-dimensional float array of identical length in that same order. Ground-truth labels must not be written, loaded for training decisions, or used outside the fixed evaluator.

model_input.description: The model must retain the existing encoded FM feature interface for prediction: predict(features) accepts a two-dimensional integer feature matrix and returns one finite score per row. Pairwise training must accept aligned positive_features and negative_features matrices with identical shape and compute BPR on score(positive_features)-score(negative_features), including existing L2 regularization and optimizer state. The trainer owns within-user sampling: users with at least one positive and one negative training impression contribute exactly one sampled positive-negative pair per training update cycle; no validation labels or test data may influence sampling.
